title: Isabella Bank Corporation Announces Third Quarter 2026 Dividend
summary: MOUNT PLEASANT, MI / ACCESS Newswire / August 27, 2026 / (Nasdaq:ISBA) today announced its Board of Directors declared a third-quarter cash dividend of $0.28 per common share at its regular meeting on August 26, 2026.

title: Isabella Bank Corporation (ISBA) Lags Q2 Earnings and Revenue Estimates
summary: Isabella Bank (ISBA) delivered earnings and revenue surprises of -25.00% and -1.93%, respectively, for the quarter ended June 2026. Do the numbers hold clues to what lies ahead for the stock?
